rationale: The short thesis remains structurally intact: price at $23.00 is still below session VWAP ($23.24) and the 9-EMA ($23.09), sitting in the low 13.7% of today's range on 3.92x relative volume in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.48%, VIXY +1.03%).
